Name: Heterochromatosis Tuxedo Cat Recolour
Author: snuffpot
Description:
I liked [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/966]beachhotdog's cat recolors[/url] but wanted their tuxedo cat with different colored eyes. This is totally based on their tuxedo cat recolor, with the green eye from their green eye cat. So they did most of the work.

How to install:
Like all the recolor mods, you just put the cat.xnb into the Stardew Valley/Content/Animals folder. Good practise to back up your current cat.xnb. (Like even just rename it cat0.xnb before putting the new one in.)

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
